name: M5 Junction 10 Improvements — UK Stage 1 (real scheme, OGL)

metadata.name: M5 Junction 10 Improvements Scheme
metadata.description: Improvements to Junction 10 on the M5 with a new road linking Junction 10 to west Cheltenham, plus A4019 widening east of the junction.
metadata.scheme_summary: Signalised motorway junction remodel; new link road; A4019 widening; pedestrian refuges at several junctions; bus stop on A4019 adjacent service road; swept-path verification for car, refuse vehicle and 7.5t box van.

scheme_description_objectives.value: Unlock housing and employment growth in west Cheltenham; improve M5 J10 capacity; three scheme elements incl. A4019 widening.

design_standards_applied.value: DMRB GG 119 audit process; DMRB geometric standards for motorway junctions.

design_speeds_and_speed_limits.value: Motorway mainline 120 km/h design context; A4019 30 mph limit through junction area.

traffic_flows_existing_forecast.value: Forecast flows for 2041 design year supplied in TA supporting the DCO application.

collision_data_analysis_36mo.value: Personal-injury collision data for the study network reviewed within the Stage 1 RSA.

vru_desire_lines.value: Pedestrian movements across A4019 at refuges and bus stop; Homecroft Drive residential access desire lines.

drawing_document_register.value: Stage 1 RSA response report incl. Figures 4-1..4-4 swept paths (private car, refuse vehicle, 7.5t box van).

provenance.license: Open Government Licence v3.0 (Planning Inspectorate NSIP library footer, explicit)
provenance.extractor: ORCH extracted scheme elements (§2), decision-log problem locations (Table 4-1: B4634 exit, central pedestrian refuges, bus stop, Homecroft Drive, central reservation gap, signal stop lines) and swept-path figure list into this Stage-1-shaped Project input set.

expected_findings_baseline.location: A4019 central pedestrian refuges at junctions near bus stop
expected_findings_baseline.scenario: Pedestrians crossing wide A4019 arms to reach the bus stop and refuge islands may be exposed to two-way conflicts where refuge capacity is insufficient for crossing demand.

statement.text: Central pedestrian refuge provision at A4019 junctions should be checked against crossing demand generated by the adjacent bus stop and service-road junction.

assumptions.text: Refuge locations shown on Stage 1 drawings remain at detailed design.

confidence.label: medium
confidence.basis: Grounded in real Stage 1 decision log; geometry not yet sighted.

expected_findings_baseline.rationale: Derived from ORCH review of the OGL-licensed M5 J10 Stage 1 RSA response report; distinguishable from quoted evidence.
expected_findings_baseline.recommendation: Provide refuge depth and width accommodating an expectant parent with a pushchair and a cycle at each A4019 crossing point adjacent the bus stop.

expected_findings_baseline.location: Homecroft Drive junction with A4019 service roads
expected_findings_baseline.scenario: Recorded large-vehicle swept paths (refuse vehicle, 7.5t box van) at Homecroft Drive must remain achievable after signal stop-line repositioning.

statement.text: Confirm the adopted swept-path envelopes for refuse vehicle and 7.5t box van remain valid where signal stop lines sit close to the Homecroft Drive junction.
statement.normative_basis_note: Exception-check analog of GG 119 problem-location recording

confidence.label: high
confidence.basis: Figures 4-2 and 4-4 exist in the response report.

expected_findings_baseline.rationale: Compliance-style question raised so the human confirms applicability; nothing silently assumed.
expected_findings_baseline.recommendation: Re-run large-vehicle swept-path analysis over the as-adjusted stop-line positions before Stage 2.

notes: Tier-0 snapshot block records what the deterministic engine emits; expected_findings_baseline is the ORCH-as-judge baseline E4 scores against. Grounded in TR010063 App 9.54 (OGL v3.0).
